name: d-stack
description: Skills for sharper questions, primary-source research, learning, and clear writing.

interface.longDescription: Twelve Markdown workflows for primary-source research, learning, questioning plans, finding reading material, and writing clear prose. For Claude Code and Codex users. Some skills require interactive question tools; grill-with-docs also requires the upstream domain-modeling skill. No MCP server or account connection is bundled.
